review.note: Reviewed every direct build, runtime, development and Node registry candidate, including outside declared bounds, against the prior 0.24.0 receipt. Every non-Core latest version, Python 3.14 support result and declaration is unchanged; the previous official release-note reviews retained in Git history remain applicable. Registry Core remains 0.42.2 and is deliberately excluded because it uses schema 8. Independently compared all 95 h2hdb package files in Core 0.44.0 wheel SHA256 8c78e6deb328421e5bb0e3c92fe1357f127a899f548267b775d4c006a896db0d with tested Core 0.43.0 v5 wheel SHA256 041bb67265cd12d6d2762841ec55c4bb996b3f697d2512bc5ddd8e47b947b966: file sets and bytes are identical. Installed the explicit local 0.44 wheel and verified every installed package file; this is not a registry installation claim. 22 targeted cases passed on Core 0.44.0: actual OPDS 1.2/2 timestamp HTTP serialization, built-wheel dependency boundaries, the schema-9 SQLite fixture and read-only startup rejection paths. The built-wheel boundary also passed on the retained Core 0.43.0 v5 environment before installation of 0.44.0. Normal pre-commit fast checks passed for the functional change. README points any still-unconverted database to the separate historical Core 0.43.0 checkout at 70ca4a35d02a50e7d6f8fd294fccb0829321eaf4; existing schema 9 needs no conversion, data deletion or CBZ rebuild. No consumer runtime shim or source behavior was added. Final exact-tree review, full gate, distribution smoke and final release-commit checks remain mandatory and are not claimed by this dependency receipt. No live external consumer, account, browser, NAS or production database was used.
